title: Pascal Jutras-Dubé
text:
Pascal Jutras-Dubé







PhD student (Computer Science) at Purdue University, advised by Ruqi Zhang. I work on generative modeling and sampling.
Seeking internships: Fall 2026, or Spring 2027.
